world.title: Lindsay Clancy trial ends without a verdict for a sixth day after drama in the courtroom
world.summary: The Lindsay Clancy trial has concluded its sixth day without a verdict. The judge did not disclose specifics about a jury room conflict, which was only briefly mentioned in open court. Reports suggest that a single juror may be preventing a unanimous decision regarding the Massachusetts mother’s criminal responsibility in the case. Further developments remain pending.

world.title: 'Didn't benefit country': Kenya ousts Tata Chemicals
world.summary: Kenya's President William Ruto announced the cessation of Tata Chemicals' operations, stating that the company's presence had not provided benefits to the country. The decision reflects the government's focus on ensuring that foreign investments contribute positively to the local economy. Ruto's directive aims to prioritize initiatives that align more closely with Kenya's development goals and community needs.

world.title: Tougher than Everest rescues: Inside Nepal's biggest airlift
world.summary: After the August 26 Bhote Koshi-Trishuli flood, severe damage to roads and bridges in Rasuwa and Nuwakot necessitated extensive helicopter airlifts for rescue operations. The helicopters became the primary means of delivering aid and evacuating stranded individuals in the affected areas. This airlift operation is considered one of the largest in Nepal's history, highlighting the challenges faced during disaster response.

business.title: Hackers stopped attacking passwords. They're attacking your consent instead.
business.summary: Cybersecurity experts warn of a new phishing technique called OAuth consent phishing, which bypasses traditional password protections. Instead of stealing passwords, attackers trick users into granting access through legitimate-looking login screens. This method allows persistent access to email, files, and cloud services, rendering password changes and multi-factor authentication ineffective. The FBI issued a public service announcement regarding this threat.

business.title: NVIDIA to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, platform will remain open to AMD and other hardware
business.summary: NVIDIA is set to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, with approximately $11.9 billion allocated for investors and up to $1 billion for employee retention. Hugging Face hosts over 3 million AI models and will continue to operate as an open platform, allowing access to AMD and other hardware providers despite the acquisition.

business.title: Volkswagen says cutting 100,000 jobs by end of decade
business.summary: Volkswagen announced plans to cut 100,000 jobs by the end of the decade, following an agreement between management and unions. This decision, revealed on September 3, 2026, is part of a significant restructuring effort in response to economic challenges. The latest reduction adds 50,000 jobs to the previously planned cuts, reflecting the company's strategic workforce alignment.

technology.title: Specs, Price and Buying Advice
technology.summary: The Honor Robot Phone features a 200MP gimbal camera and flagship specifications, priced around $1,500 in China. It combines smartphone functionality with robotic elements, offering a unique consumer tech experience. The article discusses key trade-offs and evaluates whether this experimental device is a worthwhile purchase for potential buyers, highlighting its innovative design and capabilities.

technology.title: HTC Smart Glasses Privacy Features Protect Wearers Only
technology.summary: HTC aims to enhance privacy with its VIVE Eagle smart glasses, emphasizing user protection. The AI-powered eyewear stores data locally, avoids ad tracking, and refrains from using customer data for model training. Additionally, the glasses include a light that indicates when they are recording, ensuring wearers are aware of their privacy status.

technology.title: Google September Android Update: 5 New Features
technology.summary: Google's September Android update introduces five new features across Gemini, Find Hub, Keep, and Messages, aimed at enhancing user experience. The update focuses on addressing common issues, such as locating important items and improving scrolling comfort for passengers. Availability of these features varies based on the user's Android version, emphasizing practicality over significant design changes.

sports.title: He started playing at three-and-a-half; two decades later, reached the highest-ever T20I rating: How Abhishek Sharma conquered the fastest format
sports.summary: Abhishek Sharma began playing cricket at three-and-a-half years old in Amritsar. Over two decades, he developed his skills and achieved significant success in T20 International cricket. Recently, he reached the highest-ever T20I rating, marking a notable milestone in his career. His journey reflects a remarkable rise in the fast-paced format of the sport.

sports.title: Federico Chiesa left out of Liverpool's Champions League squad
sports.summary: Federico Chiesa has been excluded from Liverpool's squad for the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League league phase. The Italy international is among those omitted by new manager Andoni Iraola, alongside Wataru Endo. Liverpool officially announced their squad ahead of the tournament, marking a significant decision regarding player selection for this prestigious European competition.

sports.title: Confirmed: Real Madrid squad list to face Real Betis | La Liga MD 4
sports.summary: Real Madrid will face Real Betis in La Liga on Matchday 4 of the 2026/27 season. The team has won all three of their league matches so far and aims to continue this winning streak. This match is particularly significant as it precedes their UEFA Champions League opener, highlighting the importance of maintaining momentum in both competitions.

health.title: Don’t panic, take necessary precautions to stay safe from swine flu, says Ludhiana Civil Surgeon
health.summary: Ludhiana Civil Surgeon Dr. Ramandeep Kaur addressed swine flu (H1N1) concerns, emphasizing that residents should not panic. She encouraged the community to stay cautious, alert, and well-informed about the virus. Dr. Kaur highlighted the importance of awareness and taking necessary precautions to prevent the spread of the viral disease, urging residents to prioritize their health and safety.

health.title: ‘The Scope Of Physiotherapy Is Wide’: Dr. Ayush Laxkar On Rehabilitation, Technology And Patient Care
health.summary: Physiotherapy has evolved into a technology-driven field, incorporating artificial intelligence, robotics, and advanced rehabilitation tools. This shift addresses changing lifestyles, including prolonged sitting and sedentary work, which have led to increased musculoskeletal issues. As a result, physiotherapy has become relevant for individuals across various age groups, highlighting its expanding scope and importance in modern healthcare.

health.title: Swine Flu Numbers Spike In Last 7 Days, Many Seek Hospitalisation
health.summary: Kolkata has experienced a significant increase in H1N1 swine flu cases over the past week, leading to a rise in hospital admissions. Many patients are presenting with severe symptoms, prompting hospitals to conduct more tests due to overlapping seasonal flu cases. Private hospitals in the city report a steady influx of patients testing positive for the virus.

science.title: A parasitic wasp turns caterpillars into zombie bodyguards; they spend their final hours protecting the larvae eating them alive
science.summary: A species of parasitic wasp has developed a unique survival strategy by transforming caterpillars into protective "bodyguards." These caterpillars, while hosting the wasp larvae, exhibit aggressive behavior towards potential predators, defending the larvae as they consume the caterpillar from within. This remarkable adaptation highlights the complex interactions between parasites and their hosts in the insect world.

science.title: Astronomers have discovered a strange object the boundary between a star and a black hole
science.summary: Astronomers have identified a unique cosmic object, named MoM-BH*-1, located in the early universe. This object displays features of both a star and a black hole, emitting a bright red light. Its size is potentially comparable to that of the entire Solar System, raising questions about its formation and the nature of celestial bodies at the universe's beginnings.

science.title: The waggle dance in honeybees: a language - beyond metaphor
science.summary: The waggle dance in honeybees conveys information about flight direction and distance to foraging locations through a specific body movement. This behavior is integral to the bees' communication system, allowing them to share vital information about resources in their environment. The dance reflects complex cognitive processes that help organize their activities and enhance the efficiency of the colony's foraging efforts.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: September 4, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 4, 2026, horoscopes suggest a wave of happiness for Scorpios, likening it to a sudden bolt of lightning. The sun is shining on them, indicating a positive shift. Scorpios are encouraged to appreciate their progress, having taken deliberate steps toward their goals. The forecast emphasizes the rewards of their efforts and the fruition of new ideas.

entertainment.title: 'Toxic' box office collections day 9: Yash starrer drops 22%; India net reaches Rs 239.30 Cr
entertainment.summary: Yash's film 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' experienced a 22% drop in box office collections on its ninth day, earning Rs 4.25 crore. The film, directed by Geetu Mohandas, has accumulated a total net of Rs 239.30 crore in India during its second-week theatrical run, according to data from Sacnilk.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: September 4, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 4, 2026, Capricorns are encouraged to focus on finances and security, as resolutions to ongoing concerns are approaching. The article suggests that the answers sought externally may actually be found within. This period signifies a transition, with the metaphor of crossing an ocean indicating that challenges are nearing resolution, providing hope for improved stability and clarity ahead.
